mentions.name: joule
mentions.description: An Obsidian plugin for quickly entering caloric and nutritional data, built around a DSL and a runtime that finds and resolves formulae recursively. Core features are complete, with documentation and convenience features remaining.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an Obsidian plugin to quickly enter caloric and nutritional data (https://www.github.com/Krishna-Sivakumar/joule). The core features are done (A DSL and a runtime for finding and resolving formulae recursively)
